title: Missing-System Topic Missions
summary: Create four deep research portfolios and eight source-bound named case files for Agriculture and Bioeconomy, AI for Science, Discovery Technologies, and Quantum.
publication_boundaries: This is an append-only synthesis over existing repository records; it does not rewrite an upstream source, signal, project, place, mission, or validation receipt.
A mapped authority rail, candidate artifact, prepared case, or longitudinal passport does not establish implementation, acceptance, recurring operation, outcome, causation, score, or rank.
No future-dated evidence check, owner disposition, publication decision, Git operation, hosted deployment, public launch, or v1 promotion is inferred.
Repository-bounded absence identifies what the inspected corpus has not established; it is never a claim that qualifying evidence does not exist elsewhere.

named_case_files.title: CFIA's 2026 plant-trait directive keeps authorization separate from adoption
named_case_files.case_kind: Existing published evidence case; project status not inferred
named_case_files.current_read: CFIA's May 2026 revision to Directive 94-08 defines the environmental safety assessment path for plants with novel traits while preserving separate product, feed, food, stewardship, and commercial stages.
named_case_files.boundary: Phase 55J publication review passed this bounded regulatory record. The signal covers the May 20, 2026 directive revision, not a product authorization. Corrections follow the public update and correction path.
named_case_files.exact_next_action: Bind the named evidence to a specific receiving place and test authority, implementation, acceptance, operation, and outcome as separate stages.

named_case_files.title: USDA backs 18 plant-breeding projects for production and resilience research
named_case_files.case_kind: Existing published evidence case; project status not inferred
named_case_files.current_read: USDA NIFA announced $10.2 million for 18 plant-breeding projects in March 2026, funding research on production traits and stresses including water, nutrients, temperature, pests, and disease without establishing field or commercial outcomes.
named_case_files.boundary: Phase 55E repair selected USDA NIFA's March 25, 2026 announcement of $10.2 million for 18 projects. Phase 55F publication review approved the bounded award-portfolio record on 2026-07-23. The release identifies funded research directions, including water and nutrient efficiency and tolerance to drought, flooding, temperature, pests, and disease. It does not report successful traits, field performance, yield, commercialization, or adoption.
named_case_files.exact_next_action: Bind the named evidence to a specific receiving place and test authority, implementation, acceptance, operation, and outcome as separate stages.
